limitations: Automated format/whole-decode/PCM/provenance/alignment review only. No claim of visual frame review, physical device speaker listening, or actual iOS/Android coverage.
sourceAudit: Targeted forbidden-write/fixture/clock pattern audit plus fresh-profile, ordinary-input and elapsed-time evidence. Read-only observation Proxy and native audio graph tap are present.
provenance: Fresh isolated profile and zero initial results. Native mouse strokes draw a fish with an eye, then a smiling hammer and crown. Ordinary Space attacks, Shift dodges and one leftward movement use real-time model observations for assistance. Initial drawing and both editing phases expire on the unchanged native timers. All three rounds are genuine outcomes, with no required win. No save fixtures, state writes, direct model calls, time injection, score edits, fabricated gameplay, microphone or third-party music.

videoAlignment.method: Original encoded frames decoded without resampling. ffprobe best_effort_timestamp_time gives the original 25fps timestamps. Adjacent source frames were visually inspected for the first indicated ink extension or hit burst; native accepted sound events supply the wall timestamps. These are measured per-scene anchors, not a guessed wall-clock offset.
videoAlignment.frameNumbering: Zero-based encoded frame index from ffprobe -show_frames.
